prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all tested kinds of change ('adoption, new_flow', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder'), as each has only 1 test.
No kind of change can be called helpful yet, as no tests have won.
No clear effect was seen for 'adoption, new_flow' and 'finish, redesign' changes.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measurements.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] waiting_screen_spotlight_redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a spotlight view with an interactive tip carousel explaining pet commands while generation completes. (why: Median waiting screen time is 201s with a 2336s mean, causing high user drop-off during long pet generation.)
1: [sign_in, redesign] sign_in_card_layout_redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a clean centered card layout with explicit account sync guidance. (why: Sign-in screen drops 27.1% of users, and 8 support tickets noted confusion around missing pets after sign-in.)
2: [choose_path, copy] choose_path_headline_copy_update: Update the headline and body text on choose_path to clearly state the simple difference between pre-made and custom pets. (why: Users take 514s on average at choose_path, indicating confusion about which path to select.)
3: [adoption, hint] upload_photos_quality_hint: Add a prominent hint box on upload_photos detailing clear lighting and face visibility requirements. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking wrong during adoption.)
4: [home, wait_info] waiting_screen_progress_indicators: Enable time estimate displays and active progress notifications on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and a mean of 2336s, leading to drop-off while waiting.)
5: [finish, hint] home_intro_desktop_controls_hint: Add an explicit interaction hint on home_intro explaining how to summon, right-click, and command the pet. (why: Support received multiple tickets from users confused about controlling or hiding their pet after setup.)
6: [choose_path, layout] choose_path_two_column_layout: Change the layout of choose_path screen to two_column for side-by-side path comparison. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users; side-by-side comparison reduces cognitive load.)

scores.note: Home step has lower drop-off than others; redesigns have shown negative lift in prior tests; costly new UI components required.
Sign-in loses 27.1% and support mails confirm user confusion, but major UI redesigns carry poor historical performance.
Choose_path has high drop-off and high completion time, though no support tickets; copy changes are low cost and low risk.
Adoption has the highest funnel drop (39.1%) with matching support tickets; adding quality hints is targeted and low risk.
Home has minor drop-off relative to adoption/finish; funnel shows long wait times; progress indicator config is simple to enable.
Finish step drops 35.2% of users and support reports post-setup confusion; adding guidance hints targets a real bottleneck.
Choose_path has notable drop-off but lacks support mail evidence; structural layout changes lack historical success and require release.
